{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert `revenue` from string to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any remaining sentinel values (e.g., 999999.99), though the earlier check found 0
# But double-checking just in case
assert (sales['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum() == 0, "Unexpected sentinel value found in revenue"

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue for this subset
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
